label: Tax rules: fetch, compare, apply - settings
aliases: tax rules: fetch, compare, apply - setti

params.name: prompt
params.default:
You are checking India's income-tax figures for Assessment Year {ay} (financial year {fy}), as enacted by the Finance Act for that year and any CBDT notification or circular since. Use only official sources: incometax.gov.in, indiabudget.gov.in, egazette.gov.in, cbic / CBDT circulars and press releases. For each item below you are given its value for AY {live_ay} and its exact JSON shape. Give the value for AY {ay} in the SAME shape (same keys, same units: rupees as whole numbers, rates as percent numbers, dates as MMDD numbers like 731 for 31 July). If AY {ay} has not been announced yet, or you are not sure, give null and say why in note.

Items:
{items}

Answer with one JSON object only, inside a ```json fence: {{"<item id>": {{"value": <value or null>, "source": "<official URL>", "note": "<one short line: what changed, or why null>"}}, ...}} - every item id once. Also give the key "_new": a list of the other income-tax changes for AY {ay} that affect an individual's return and are NOT among the items above (a new section, fee, deduction, exemption, return form or schedule change, due-date rule, JSON schema version), each {{"what": "<one line>", "who": "<who it affects>", "source": "<official URL>"}}; [] if none.
params.label: prompt

params.name: ai_timeout
params.label: seconds a Fetch may take (the AI searches the web first)

description_nl: 2026-10-06: the AY the portal's live figures are for (live_ay - Apply moves it on), the AI that fetches (Gemini with Google Search, official sources only), its prompt, and how its answer is read. Apply publishes through the Ops & chips builder layer (data/builder/chips), so a deploy never undoes it and each chip keeps its History. 2026-10-06: the prompt also asks for the changes that are not one of the items ("_new") - they cannot be applied as a figure; Compare shows them as needs building. new_most: how many are kept. 2026-10-06: ais - the models Fetch may ask, each searching the web itself; Automatic takes the first whose key works. 2026-10-06: ai_timeout - how long a Fetch may take. 2026-10-06: fence is the fence marks only (json_in_text removes what it matches - the old pattern took the answer with it). 2026-10-07: check_every_days - Tax rules asks for a re-check of the live year when the last Fetch is older (circulars come all year).
